name: 5.2 V10 NA
notes: Variant: Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4 coupé (2014-2019; 5,204 cc 90-degree V10, 449 kW / 610 CV at 8,250 rpm, revs to 8,700 rpm; 7-speed LDF dual-clutch; rear-biased AWD) on the standard rear 305/30 R20 tyre. Driven tyre is the REAR: the LDF's integrated final drive and mechanical diff lock turn the rear axle, while the front axle is fed by a prop shaft from the second output shaft through a multi-plate clutch. Combustion: common-pin crankshaft with alternating 90/54-degree firing intervals and firing order 1-6-5-10-2-7-3-8-4-9 (Audi; Lamborghini: 'fires alternately at 54 and 90 degrees'). The two cylinders on a shared pin fire 90 degrees apart and each five-cylinder bank fires every 144 degrees, so the entries (cylinders 1/6/5/10/2/7/3/8/4/9) sit at 0/90/144/234/288/378/432/522/576/666 degrees and the banks strictly alternate. Banks follow Audi numbering: bank 1 = cylinders 1-5 (fired 1-5-2-3-4) = bank 0; bank 2 = cylinders 6-10 = bank 1. The earlier Audi S6/S8 5.2 FSI used an 18-degree split-pin crank with even 72-degree firing; that is not modelled. Gearbox: no Lamborghini document found lists the LDF gear ratios, so the documented variant is the Audi R8 Coupé V10 GT RWD (2023), which has the same 5.2 FSI V10 and the same 7-speed dual-clutch family. Its Audi eTD lists gear ratios 3.133/2.588/1.958/1.244/0.979/0.976/0.841 with final drives 4.893 / 3.938 on the Huracán's 245/30 | 305/30 R20 tyres. The per-gear final-drive mapping comes from Audi UK (April 2016) and Audi of America (2018) technical data for the R8 V10 plus, which uses the same gear set: drive I for reverse, 1st, 4th and 5th; drive II for 2nd, 3rd, 6th and 7th. Applied to the taller R8 V10 gear set (3.133/2.588/1.880/1.140/0.898/0.884/0.653 x 4.458 / 3.588), the same mapping reproduces the overall ratios in Audi's R8 V10 419 kW eTD (13.969/9.287/6.746/5.080/4.003/3.171/2.343). Overall ratio = gear x 4.893 (1st, 4th, 5th) or gear x 3.938 (2nd, 3rd, 6th, 7th). Source conflict: those Audi UK and Audi of America sheets print the R8 V10 plus final drives as 4.458 / 3.588. With 7th 0.841 that would give N/V about 38.5 rpm/mph, against the EPA's 43.0 (axle 3.94) for the MY2018 610 hp R8. The values are therefore treated as copied from the R8 V10 column; the GT eTD's 4.893 / 3.938 agrees with the EPA axle ratio 3.94 on every Huracán row and every R8 V10 plus / performance quattro row. The taller R8 V10 gear set is not the Huracán's and is not modelled. It appears in Audi's EU eTDs for the R8 V10 quattro 419 kW and V10 performance quattro 456 kW (overall 13.969...2.343) and in the US EPA rows with axle 3.59, N/V about 30. EPA cross-check: every Huracán row MY2015-2024 lists 7 gears, axle 3.94, N/V 42.8 (MY2019 Spyder: 43.0); the model gives 7th 0.841 x 3.938 on 305/30R20 = 42.19 rpm/mph (-1.4 %). Estimated (not published in the sources used): idle 850 rpm; limiter type fuel-soft with 150 rpm hysteresis, at the published 8,700 rpm maximum engine speed (Audi: 26.9 m/s mean piston speed 'at the engine speed limiter' = 8,700 rpm x 2 x 92.8 mm); redline taken as that 8,700 rpm maximum; shift time 0.10 s (DCT default). Audi says R8 launch control engages the clutch at around 4,500 rpm; voicing launchRpm stays the generated default.
